brief.subject: A coil of rope with a small lit lantern hanging from it — the item icon for the Rope Lantern item
brief.gameplayMeaning: Inventory icon identifying the rope lantern item; must read as the rope coil plus a tiny hanging lantern, distinct from the plain rope icon
visualPriority: first read as rope coil with a hanging lantern
then show the warm lantern glow against the brown coil
share the rope and lantern palettes of the block textures

mustHave: coil rings in the upper two-thirds
lantern with dark caps, orange glass and bright glow hanging at the bottom center
a small hanger link between coil and lantern
mustNotHave: lantern large enough to dominate the icon
